scope: Focused follow-up to prior phase research; research is not proof of Mini Hivo behavior.

references.title: The Tail at Scale
references.mechanism: Measure latency variability and service-level amplification; distributed-service mitigation experiments.
references.adaptation: Measurement-informed bounded phase handling; reject hedged duplicate inference on one CPU provider.
references.limits: Different workloads; no agent correctness or timing-constant proof.

references.title: Tool calling with streaming
references.adaptation: Preserve accumulation, admit a response only after done=true inside all limits; do not dispatch partial calls.
Retain Sarathi-Serve prefill/decode distinction and least-privilege independent verification; no GPU scheduler or extra reflection calls.
